breakdown.description: The wall is labeled adiabatic (zero heat flux) but a fixed temperature boundary condition is simultaneously imposed on the same surface.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the contradictory boundary conditions. The original prompt stated the wall was adiabatic (dT/dx=0) at x=0 while also having a fixed temperature T(0)=350 K. The agent resolved this by creating a well-posed problem, applying the fixed temperature condition to one side (x=0) and the adiabatic condition to the other side (x=L). This is a standard interpretation to make the problem solvable and aligns with the ground truth's primary suggestion.
